capture_mode: deterministic hidden in-app replay through canvas_input
cursor_cue: A synthetic pointer ring is labeled DRAW while drawing, SELECT while editing, and ORBIT during camera navigation; persistent text discloses synthetic input and no pressure data.

encoding.gif: Accelerated six-second preview of the same 60 replay checkpoints; plays once without a loop extension. Use the captioned MP4 master for normal-speed instruction.
encoding.mp4: Captured full-viewport RGBA frames; Blender H.264 fallback; 10 fps; repeated frame holds preserve the 60s duration.
encoding.poster: Selected full-resolution action frame encoded as PNG.

input_note: This deterministic tutorial uses synthetic pressure=None pointer samples. Drawing, selection, transform, undo/redo, native save, and native reopen use production app handlers. MP4 checkpoints are held to make the action steps readable; no tablet pressure or latency was measured.
license_or_provenance: Original Japanese garden-house scene built into Sketch3D; the stroke and transforms are created during capture by production editing handlers.

poster.alt: Selected cyan detail stroke and move gizmo in clear canvas above the garden-house.

outputs.gif_preview: Accelerated 6-second preview; use the MP4 and timed VTT for normal-speed playback.

review.notes: Synthetic 60-second tutorial with captured draw/select/move/undo/redo and production native save/reopen steps. The GIF is an accelerated six-second preview; use the MP4 and VTT for instruction. Reviewed GIF key frames at 0/10/20/30/40/50, checked selected full-resolution posters, compared all VTT cues with action checkpoints, and validated VTT order/duration. Confirmed GIFs have no loop extension and scanned manifests/media for private paths. Full native-resolution motion/readability and rendered README-surface review remain pending.

shot_steps: Draw a detail on the front plane, then select and move it through the production selection handlers.
Undo and redo the transform, orbit the camera, then save and reopen through production native document paths.
The native save is stored next to the recording as a sample document.
